about.title: The Standard
about.body: Founded in 2017 as a boutique fitness studio in Nicosia, Quantum Gym evolved into a dedicated bodybuilding and strength center focused on measurable progress. Today we are the premier powerlifting training center in Cyprus — known for top-of-the-line equipment, expert coaching, and a supportive community.
about.imageAlt: Athlete performing a heavy dumbbell press under the Quantum Gym sign
